metadata.description: Magic: The Gathering deckbuilding tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: mtg-deckbuilder
plugins.description: Build, validate and playtest professional-quality MTG decks using only cards you own: collection CSV parsing (Moxfield/Archidekt/Deckbox/ManaBox), Scryfall-verified card data with a shared cache, format-aware quality gates, a Monte Carlo goldfish simulator, Moxfield-ready decklists and self-contained HTML reports.
